5743.title: [release] Document the dedicated SkiaSharp NuGet publisher
5743.body:
* [release] Document the dedicated SkiaSharp NuGet publisher

Replace retired MAUI publication instructions with pipeline 1715's Runs API contract, exact producer Build-number selection, live production resource verification, and signed shipping artifact boundary. Preserve ESRP approval and separate Finish consent, and document reporting rather than replaying failed or partial publications.

Update audit output and its existing regression checks so command-line guidance cannot route maintainers back to MAUI.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* [release] Tighten publisher guidance against production receipts

Consolidate the operator procedure and remove repeated guidance. Clarify producer run lookup, Azure parameter read-back, NuGet propagation and separate Finish authorization.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* [release] Clarify publisher review guidance

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

---------

5784.title: Remove Linux x86 native build and packaging
5784.body:
Follow upstream .NET removal of linux-x86 cross-build infrastructure
(dotnet/runtime#136997, dotnet/runtime#137008, dotnet/arcade#17770,
dotnet/dotnet-buildtools-prereqs-docker#1821) by dropping the Linux x86
cross-compilation Dockerfile, CI jobs, native artifact checks, and
NuGet package entries.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
